The verdict is **fix**: the [Catalog](/framework/catalog/) page doesn't yet meet the owner's preview ask. I wrote the [report](public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/review-site-pages/review/report.md); I was given all four widths for every page, and the catalog was shot on the main site only.

### Catalog `/framework/catalog/`
- ⚠️ No preview card shows on the first screen at any width; it starts with text, three links and three class cards.
- ⚠️ The "40 previews in under 2 s" test is not met. The page's own `doc/next.md` says live iframes can't meet it and records the next brief.
- ⚠️ At 1920 and 3440 the page stays in a narrow column, about 75% of the screen empty. It is 16 screens long at 1920 and 75 at 400.
- ⚠️ The "Refine" class card is empty, with no "extends" line and no methods.

---

### Object `/framework/ux/Content/Object/`
- ⚠️ The new InstanceTree tab pushes the tab bar onto 2 rows at 1200.
- The page is blank on the main site at all four widths, but the worktree build renders. Check it again after the merge.

---

### Surfaces, tokens, InstanceTree
- ✅ [Voice and chat surfaces](/framework/ux/Dictate/surfaces/) says, for every surface, where it is, its file, who answers and where it writes.
- ✅ [Figma tokens](/framework/ext/Figma/tokens/) shows the pairs of Figma variable and site property, with colour swatches.
- ✅ [InstanceTree](/framework/ux/Content/Object/instance-tree/) shows the demo beside the live tree.
